sloka: हनुमन् सिंहसङ्काशावुभौ तौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ।सुग्रीवं च सहामात्य सर्वान् ब्रूया ह्यनामयम् ।। ५.६७.३५ ।।।।
transliteration: hanuman siṁhasaṅkāśāvubhau tau rāmalakṣmaṇau ।sugrīvaṁ ca sahāmātya sarvān brūyā hyanāmayam ।। 5.67.35 ।।।।

translations.english: "Addressed thus by Sita, I spoke to Maithili: 'Lady, delight of Janaka, mount swiftly upon my back,
